snippet.title: Kill The Hero #gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
#indiegame #dungeon #autobattler #towerdefense 

Build the dungeon. Outsmart the heroes. Kill them all.

Kill The Hero is a dungeon building strategy game where you design deadly layouts, place traps and guards, research new technologies and use powerful cards when the heroes invade.

Your dungeon is the weapon. Every attack puts your design to the test.

Wishlist Kill The Hero on Steam!
